goal: Compare three canonical semantic artifact designs under identical deterministic and real-Provider conditions, select only a qualified winner, and integrate only that winner into L6 project generation.
delivery_approach: hybrid governed experiment: freeze L0-L5 and production L6 semantics during A/B/C comparison, then conditionally integrate a data-qualified winner
acceptance_criteria: A, B, and C express the same ten semantic facts and use the same Provider models, budgets, public cases, hidden acceptance, timeouts, and evaluator
all designs deterministically reject malformed, stale, dangling, cyclic, contract-incompatible, or hash-unstable artifacts
workers receive current source, interface manifests, direct semantic dependencies, public acceptance subset, and structured failure evidence
repair preserves the original tree, DAG identity, semantic state, successful-node state, and performs affected-only rerun

a production winner is selected only if CLI succeeds at least two of three times, seeded repair passes, no breaking interface is accepted, no whole-project repair replan occurs, and manual edits remain zero

quality_metrics.measure: configuration and fact-set parity across A/B/C
quality_metrics.actual: PASS: same models, budgets, cases, evaluator, hidden acceptance, and independent workspaces

quality_metrics.measure: schema, round-trip, reference, stale-state, interface, and attribution tests
quality_metrics.actual: PASS: 19 schema tests and 6 fake-provider integration tests

quality_metrics.measure: real CLI repeatability and seeded repair
quality_metrics.actual: NEEDS_REWORK: A/B/C repair PASS; A/B/C CLI 0/3

quality_metrics.measure: accepted breaking changes, whole replans, manual candidate edits, hidden leakage
quality_metrics.actual: PASS: all zero and hidden source was not exposed

feedback: Do not integrate the highest-scoring unqualified design.
Close acceptance-obligation completeness before another envelope experiment.

worked: fixed A/B/C protocol and rubric prevented preference-driven selection
deterministic manifests and guards prevented accepted interface regression
seeded repair preserved tree continuity and affected-only rerun
did_not_work: all real CLI generations missed the same acceptance boundaries
Design A did not implement three separately named fine-grained refinements from its original sketch
experiments: Compare artifact representation rather than Provider strength while holding all business facts and budgets constant.
Next test should validate executable acceptance-obligation completeness before Provider generation.
